_comment: Issued-password allow-list for app-level login (Step 3, Option A). Only bcrypt HASHES are stored here (irreversible) — never plaintext passwords. Add a user by generating a hash with `python -c "import bcrypt; print(bcrypt.hashpw(b'THEPASSWORD', bcrypt.gensalt()).decode())"` and adding an entry. The real file (allowed_users.json) is baked into the deploy image; distribute plaintext passwords to users out-of-band.
